Outside your window, solar panels gleam in the sunlight while hydroponic gardens sway in the breeze, embodying a sustainable ecosystem. Organic market stalls and tech startups coexist harmoniously, celebrating resilience and cooperation.

However, beneath this idyll, tension exists as factories transform into cooperative workshops, navigating local currencies, barter systems, debt, and exploitation. The city stands at the precipice of transformation, balancing between promise and peril as it forges ahead towards a better future.
